import glob,json
rows=[]
for f in sorted(glob.glob("*.receipt.json")):

print(len(rows),"receipts; nonzero/killed:",[x for x in rows if x[1]!=0 or x[2]])

print(open("search-charges.jsonl").read().count("\n"),"charges")
